description.text: Pregunta 47Which statement describes the characteristics of packet-filtering and stateful firewalls as they relate to the OSI model?

Both stateful and packet-filtering firewalls can filter at the application layer.

description.text: Pregunta 54Two network engineers are discussing the methods used to forward frames through a switch. What is an important concept related to the cut-through method of switching?
